entities.summary: Rukhsana Parveen also spelled Rukhsana Perveen is a female boxer from Pakistan. In 2016, she along with two other teammates became the first women boxers from Pakistan to compete in an international competition when they participated at the South Asian Games in Guwahati, India. She was also included in the first ever team sent to the Asian Games. Rukhsana Parveen was a athletes & competitors from Pakistan (b. 1992, Pakistan). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
